author: raymond91125
body:
[Written by Claude]

Dear all,

The proposal has been made to obsolete the following three terms:

- GO:0034631 microtubule anchoring at spindle pole body
- GO:1990734 astral microtubule anchoring at mitotic spindle pole body
- GO:1990810 microtubule anchoring at mitotic spindle pole body

see https://github.com/geneontology/go-ontology/issues/32155

They are being replaced by a molecular function, **GO:7770121 microtubule-spindle pole body anchor activity**, which is already merged (https://github.com/geneontology/go-ontology/pull/32618). The anchoring is a bridging binding activity rather than a multistep process: Toya 2007 (PMID:17486116) shows Msd1 anchors microtubule minus ends to the SPB through the gamma-tubulin complex, separably from nucleation, and Yukawa 2015 (PMID:25987607) shows Pkl1 motor activity is not required for the anchoring role once targeted to the SPB. Direct precedent for retiring a BP of this shape in favour of an MF anchor activity: GO:0007016 -> GO:0106006 and GO:0090286 -> GO:0140444.

Experimental annotations that need to be reviewed:

*No Google spreadsheet yet — someone with access will need to create one. The full set is small enough to list inline (retrieved from GOlr).*

| Object | Term | Ev | Reference | Group | Proposed destination |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| PomBase:SPBC13E7.06 msd1 | GO:1990810 | IMP | PMID:25987607 | PomBase | GO:7770121 |
| PomBase:SPBC32H8.09 wdr8 | GO:1990810 | IMP | PMID:25987607 | PomBase | GO:7770121 |
| PomBase:SPAC3A11.14c pkl1 | GO:1990810 | IMP | PMID:25987607 | PomBase | GO:7770121 |
| PomBase:SPAC3A11.14c pkl1 | GO:1990810 | IMP | PMID:29167352 | PomBase | GO:7770121 (redundant, see note 3) |
| PomBase:SPBC365.15 alp4 | GO:1990734 | IMP | PMID:17486116 | PomBase | GO:7770121 (see note 2) |
| PomBase:SPAC664.10 klp2 | GO:1990810 | IGI | PMID:29167352 | PomBase | **do not transfer, see note 1** |
| ComplexPortal:CPX-26534 mwp_schpo | GO:1990810 | IDA | PMID:25987607 | ComplexPortal | GO:7770121 |
| PomBase:SPAC3A11.14c pkl1 | GO:1990810 | IDA | PMID:25987607 | ComplexPortal | GO:7770121 |
| PomBase:SPBC13E7.06 msd1 | GO:1990810 | IDA | PMID:25987607 | ComplexPortal | GO:7770121 |
| PomBase:SPBC32H8.09 wdr8 | GO:1990810 | IDA | PMID:25987607 | ComplexPortal | GO:7770121 |
| SGD:S000000045 SPC72 | GO:1990734 | IMP | PMID:12970190 | SGD | GO:7770121 (see note 2) |

GO:0034631 has no annotations of any evidence type.

Impacted groups:

1. PomBase — 6 EXP (5 IMP, 1 IGI)
2. ComplexPortal — 4 IDA
3. SGD — 1 IMP
4. GO_Central — 10 IBA (PAINT), will need repropagating
5. EnsemblFungi (13) and TreeGrafter (1) — 14 IEA, regenerated automatically

Notes:

1. **klp2 needs fixing regardless of this obsoletion.** The IGI to GO:1990810 is contradicted by its own reference, PMID:29167352: "Pkl1 is tethered to the spindle pole body, whereas Klp2 is localized along the spindle microtubule." The only SPB-linked Klp2 result in that paper is a forced-targeting experiment, i.e. artificial mislocalisation, not normal function. Klp2's role there is inward force generation against Cut7/kinesin-5. Suggest removing or re-terming rather than transferring.
2. Neither SPC72 nor alp4 binds a microtubule directly — both act through the gamma-tubulin complex. Since Msd1 is the founding case for the new MF and also works through gamma-TuC, indirect bridging counts, and both transfer. Both are currently under GO:1990734 in error: alp4's evidence in PMID:17486116 concerns spindle rather than astral microtubules, and PMID:12970190 does not restrict SPC72 to mitosis. Collapsing to one non-mitotic MF resolves both.
3. pkl1's second IMP, to PMID:29167352, is redundant with its IMP to PMID:25987607 and weakly supported by that reference (the assay is cut7 bypass, not anchorage). Low priority.

----

Mappings that need to be reviewed: **none found.** I checked the published external2go files for all three GO IDs — interpro2go, uniprotkb_kw2go, hamap2go and ec2go all return zero hits. UniRule and ARBA are not published in external2go, so those were not checkable from here and may still want a look.

Thanks.

The 10 IBA annotations will need repropagating once the direct annotations move (GO_Central, no assignee added).

author: raymond91125
body:
[Written by Claude]

Obsoletion PR is open: https://github.com/geneontology/go-ontology/pull/32619 (not merged — sequencing against this review is the editors' call).

Two things surfaced while preparing it:

**FYPO needs repointing.** Ubergraph shows FYPO:0004623 "abolished astral microtubule anchoring at mitotic spindle pole body" references both GO:1990734 and GO:0034631. @valwood — this is a PomBase product, so it lands with you alongside the annotations.

**klp2 is still the open question** (note 1 in the description). The obsoletion PR uses `consider: GO:7770121` on all three terms, so a blanket redirect would send klp2 somewhere its own reference contradicts.
